name: The Full Price
pitch: Pay your arts in spirit stones and no pool limits them: half a second in, before anyone can act, you buy a top-end cultivator's death for 45,000 stones, if a purse that size can ever be carried.

new.name: Priced Above the Sea
new.effect: A stone-paid art may have cost_share above 1, and the art lint applies unchanged.
new.second_home: any resource-swap build, such as blood-paid arts

new.name: Rush Order
new.effect: +50 % price: the art's first firing comes at half its effective cooldown.
new.second_home: any alpha strike, First Move builds

new.name: Bulk Order
new.effect: +25 points to an art per full share of its cost.
new.second_home: any costly art, Heavy Hand builds

new.name: Purse Weight
new.effect: +30 points per doubling of carried stones above the realm's linh_thach_max, read at the start of a fight, within the L3 cap.

new.name: Exact Change
new.effect: Overkill on a winning hit refunds that share of its price, up to half.
new.second_home: any priced art, refunding blood or stock

new.name: Collected Debt
new.effect: On a knockout, take 10 % of the loser's carried stones.

new.name: Seal of Full Payment
new.effect: Named artifact, an base. Arts and the ward may be paid in spirit stones; linh lực pays for nothing; carried stones show on your profile; a winner who takes you takes the seal.

new.name: Weights and Measures Sutra
new.effect: Main, Thiên giai, Metal. Abilities Earnest Money, Buyout, Ruinous Offer; lists Counting Beads.

new.name: Earnest Money
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 4.0, share 0.25, cooldown 1 s.

new.name: Buyout
new.effect: Body hit, c_art 13, share 1, cooldown 1 s, guard own health below 75 %, so it fires in a follow-up instant.

new.name: Ruinous Offer
new.effect: Body hit, c_art 25, share 2, rushed to t = 0.5.

new.name: Indemnity Ward
new.effect: A per-pulse ward whose premium is paid in stones, so linh lực is never touched.

new.name: Counting Beads
new.effect: Sealed, theme the Market economy, Metal, size 7: art cost, Metal damage, Full Sea.

new.name: Way of Trade
new.effect: Requires Metal at purity 40. Branches The Scale, The Road, The Ledger; keystone Priced Above the Sea.

new.name: Debt
new.effect: Spirit stones may fall below 0 through On Credit, with interest, heart demon and a collector. Also serves a creditor build and a build borrowing from its future.

questions: A Core cultivator kills a same-realm top-end for about 10,000 to 45,000 stones. Is stone_rate 2 the right order of magnitude?
Should a build be able to act before t = 1 at all? Rush Order is the sharpest rule-bend here.
Rule 18 wants a top-end build to need 4 s against an ordinary boss. This shot ends a x4 typical boss at 0.5 s. Acceptable at this price?
Is debt a system you want?
Can a Core cultivator ever hold 80,000 stones, 16 times the ceiling on one event reward? If not, what purse is real, and does legend survive it?
